project.name: AI2050 语言编码机制全局结构辨识
project.north_star: 识别能够以低描述长度预测未知世界、未知干预、多步生成、组合与跨模型响应的功能状态及其转移结构。
project.theory_status: 条件化输出场闭合理论与 RDC 术语保持不变。C013 supports predictive functional equivalence as the correct estimand and independently sourced donor rescue as a valid known-truth subobject, while showing that point-threshold abstention is unstable for risk-boundary systems. Functional state should be typed by a risk-qualified quotient with an explicit unresolved boundary region. Existing linear algebra, conditional dynamics, intervention, quotient and elementary error-bound language remain sufficient; no new foundational mathematics is authorized.

framework.title: 语言计算系统辨识研发框架
framework.north_star: 寻找能够预测未见语言条件、内部干预和生成轨迹的最小经验规律。

current.campaign_name: Predictive functional equivalence and independent-rescue calibration
current.bottleneck: Phase1263/C013 changed the estimand from hidden generator identity to a reference-risk predictive functional quotient and separated independent donor rescue from algebraic replay. Exact class recovery was 318/320 and abstention 82/84: two equivalence-overlap systems straddled the frozen 0.050 risk boundary across reference panels but fell just below it on selection. All applicable response, independent rescue, wrong-identity, control and leakage-sentinel gates passed. The bottleneck is finite-sample certification of boundary abstention, not candidate capacity.
current.next_decision: C013 is closed before free-network execution. Do not delete the two overlap systems, widen the pass threshold, rerun seeds, or treat the successful algebraic replay sentinel as mediation. Any future campaign must preregister a finite-sample stability certificate or interval-valued quotient and prove it on fresh margin/boundary systems before external validity.
current.decision_title: Close C013 at the finite-sample abstention boundary and preserve independent rescue separately

puzzles.blocker: 没有统一响应张量，候选结构尚未竞赛。

puzzles.name: 内容—角色—协议因子化

puzzles.name: 自回归生成闭环
puzzles.blocker: 现有候选、trie 和句式行为不等于自然全词表因果生成。

puzzles.name: 语言操作组合律
puzzles.blocker: 五原子只有窄行为资格，家族行为与单点因果链没有闭合。

puzzles.name: 跨模型功能同构
puzzles.blocker: 尚无任何一个对象在单模型达到 L5。

puzzles.name: 训练形成机制
puzzles.blocker: 时钟构念已校准，但自由网络外部效度和当前形成前摘要预测失败。

puzzles.name: 自然语言外部效度
puzzles.blocker: 受控对象尚未完成 L5/L6，直接扩展自然语言会重新进入对象迁移循环。

puzzles.name: 新数学升级门
puzzles.blocker: 当前缺口是经验对象未识别，而不是现有数学无法表达。
